f2670d8ab541d167f0e354a6dc2aaebe4d1f9529.summary: A Linux how-to guide on scheduling one-time jobs with the at command: entering times, listing and removing queued jobs, controlling user access, and the batch command. It is administrative documentation, not a threat report, so no threat actors, malware, vulnerabilities or incidents are described.

f23f9a480c5cdd7c79dd78ef6536520d24cf0551.summary: A CSO article, published 2021-02-01, summarising CrowdStrike research on Sprite Spider, a ransomware group that evolved from the Shifu banking Trojan (2015) through the Vatet loader, the PyXie RAT, and the DEFRAY777 ransomware (2019). From July 2020 it targeted VMware ESXi hosts, using stolen credentials against vCenter to encrypt virtual machines. The article links the group to commodity malware such as TrickBot, Dridex and Emotet, compares its kill chain to nation-state APT activity, and gives defence advice from CrowdStrike and Check Point.
